t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the size and shape of the gnomes do not matter, pay attention to the colour of the gnomes and the ultimate goal is to get as many mushrooms as possible.

vb_textbox.text: the gnomes are fixed in colour pairs, orange + brown, green + pink, red+ yellow, blue and purple!the size position and hat size are not important. focus on the particular forest each selection takes you!
